+title: 'MTP: make the drafter state a portable cache value (copy, byte count, serialize, cold start)'
+---
+## What
+Two separate prompt caches must carry the MTP drafter state (drafter KV cache + pending hidden row) next to the main cache:
+- ChatSession: `RealizedCache` (Libraries/MLXLMCommon/ChatSession.swift ~365-411), `PromptCacheCheckpoint` (Libraries/MLXLMCommon/PromptCacheCheckpoint.swift), and `PromptCacheSnapshot` (Libraries/MLXLMCommon/KVCache.swift ~2340-2400).
+- FoundationModels: `ExecutorPromptCacheEntry` (Libraries/MLXFoundationModels/ExecutorPromptCache.swift ~33-107), its checkpoint, and its spill file (Libraries/MLXFoundationModels/ExecutorPromptCacheFile.swift).
+
+Give both caches one shared value type, so that the drafter rules are written one time. Rules that research found:
+- The drafter caches must NOT go into the `caches: [KVCache]` array. The template restore requires the same layer count as the model (KVCache.swift ~2496), and the offset checks compare every cache with the token ledger (ExecutorPromptCache.swift ~1281-1303, ExecutorPromptCacheFile.swift ~150-154).
+- The pending hidden row must NOT go into `LMOutput.State`. There it sets `carriesModelState`, which turns off `RewindToCommonPrefixRule` (PromptCacheReusePolicy.swift ~76-78, ~325).
+- A drafter state cannot be trimmed by itself. Drafter entry j pairs token j+1 with target hidden j, so a rewind to length L needs the target hidden row L−1, and no cache keeps it. Thus a drafter state is either aligned (from the same call, or from a checkpoint taken at the same position) or it is dropped.
+
+- [ ] Add `MTPDrafterCacheState` in Libraries/MLXLMCommon/MTPDrafterModel.swift (or a new file Libraries/MLXLMCommon/MTPDrafterCacheState.swift) that wraps `MTPDrafterState` with: `processedTokenCount`, `pendingHidden`, `copy()` (deep enough for fork), `byteCount`, and `isAligned(withMainTokenCount:)` (true only when drafter == main − 1 and `pendingHidden` is present).
+- [ ] Add `arrays() -> [String: MLXArray]` and `metadata() -> [String: String]` with reserved key prefixes (for example `__mlx_lm_mtp_drafter_`), and a throwing `init(arrays:metadata:drafter:)` that checks the format version, the drafter model identity, and the offsets.
+- [ ] Define the cold start: when a main cache of P tokens has no aligned drafter state, the iterator makes an empty drafter state at position P (RoPE positions start at P). Correctness does not depend on the drafter, because the target verifies every token; only the acceptance is lower until the drafter cache fills. Replace the word "rebuild" in the other MTP tasks with this cold start. Do not replay the target over the prefix.
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+- [ ] A round trip through `arrays()` / `init(arrays:...)` gives a drafter state that continues a stream with the same greedy tokens as the original.
+- [ ] `copy()` gives two states that continue independently.
+- [ ] A cold-started drafter on a cached prefix gives the same greedy tokens as plain decode, and the test records its acceptance against a warm drafter.
+
+## Tests
+- [ ] Tests/MLXLMTests/MTPDrafterCacheStateTests.swift: round trip, copy independence, alignment checks, reject of a wrong format version or wrong offsets, cold-start equality on the random Qwen35 + MTP fixture.
+- [ ] `swift build --build-tests && xcrun xctest .build/out/Products/Debug/MLXLMTests.xctest` passes.
+
+## Workflow
+- Use `/tdd` — write failing tests first, then implement to make them pass. #mtp #qwen38 #kv-cache
\ No newline at end of file

+  text: |-
+    Picked up. Research:
+    - Per the earlier comment, extend `MTPDrafterContinuation` (MTPDrafterModel.swift) instead of adding `MTPDrafterCacheState`. Its fields: `state: MTPDrafterState`, `targetBoundaryHidden` (= the spec's pendingHidden, never nil in this type), `targetProcessedTokenCount` (= processedTokenCount). Made only by `MTPSpeculativeTokenIterator.finalizeDrafterContinuation`, which leaves `nextPosition == targetProcessedTokenCount - 1`, `proposalAppended == 0`, seeds nil (removeLastEntries drops them).
+    - The deep copy lives inline in `ChatSession.RealizedCache.copy()` (copies each drafter KVCache). Moving it to `MTPDrafterContinuation.copy()` gives ^achvxy1 one call and keeps the rule in one place.
+    - No drafter identity exists. The continuation must carry the identity of the drafter that made it, so the drafter must expose one: add `drafterID` to `ResumableMTPDrafterModel` (default = type name; Qwen LLM/VLM drafters = type name + hash of the sorted-key JSON of their configuration). MLXLMCommon builds on Linux (Libraries/MLXLMCommon/Linux), so no CryptoKit: FNV-1a 64.
